indicator.description: Values of one indicator for one or more countries (ISO2/ISO3 codes joined with ';', or 'all'), one row per country and period.

country.desc: ISO2 or ISO3 codes, several joined with ';' (US;GB;DE), an aggregate (WLD, OED, HIC, EUU) or 'all'

indicator.desc: indicator code (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), catalog alias (gdp_per_capita), or a list of them (sent ';'-joined with source=2 unless source is set); the adapter resolves aliases and requires it

date.desc: year or range: 2024, 2000:2024; monthly/quarterly series use 2020M01:2020M12 / 2020Q1:2020Q4

mrv.desc: most recent N values per country (instead of date)

mrnev.desc: most recent N non-empty values per country

gapfill.desc: Y fills mrv gaps with the previous value (use with care)

frequency.desc: with mrv: Y, Q or M

source.desc: source database id when the code exists in several (2 = WDI); required by the API for several indicators (the pack sets 2)

indicator_info.description: Metadata of one indicator: name, unit, source database, definition (sourceNote), source organization.

indicator.desc: one indicator code or alias (the adapter resolves aliases and requires it)

countries.description: Countries and aggregates with ISO codes, region, income level and lending type (aggregates have region.id NA).

source_indicators.description: Every indicator of one source database (2 = World Development Indicators, about 1,500 indicators).

source_id.desc: source id from the sources endpoint (2 = WDI)

topic_indicators.description: Indicators of one topic (1 Agriculture, 3 Economy and growth, 4 Education, 8 Health, 11 Poverty, 19 Climate change, ...).

topic_id.desc: topic id from the topics endpoint

sources.description: Source databases (WDI, Doing Business, International Debt Statistics, ...).

gdp.name: GDP (current US$)
gdp.description: gross domestic product, current US dollars at market exchange rates

gdp_lcu.name: GDP (current LCU)
gdp_lcu.description: GDP in current local currency units

gdp_per_capita.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
gdp_per_capita.description: income per person, current US dollars

gdp_per_capita_ppp.name: GDP per capita, PPP (current international $)
gdp_per_capita_ppp.description: income per person at purchasing power parity, for level comparisons

exchange_rate.name: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)

health_spending_pc.name: Current health expenditure per capita (current US$)

unemployment.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)

labor_force_participation.name: Labor force participation rate, total (% of population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)

govt_debt.name: Central government debt, total (% of GDP)
govt_debt.description: public debt central government, sparse coverage

exports_gdp.name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)

imports_gdp.name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)

education_spending_gdp.name: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)

tertiary_spending_share.name: Expenditure on tertiary education (% of government expenditure on education)

rd_spending_gdp.name: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)

co2_per_capita.name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
co2_per_capita.description: co2 emissions climate energy (replaces the archived EN.ATM.CO2E.PC)

internet_users.name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
